evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live central custom-interface registry.
The builder owns the 41900-series magic presentation/filter surface and patches spellbook-related widgets including 41900-41914 plus linked spellbook roots in the 45xxx range.
Exact controls include 'Magic spellbook filter', 'Spell Filters', 'Show Combat spells', 'Show Teleport spells', 'Show Utility spells' and a low-level spell visibility filter.

Exact surviving names/descriptions span surge, miasmic and lunar/utility spell presentation, rune labels and teleport helpers, proving this is a spellbook catalogue/presentation surface rather than one individual spell.
Exact-v308 reverse references include Client, central interface construction and live render/input paths; the class also owns persistent filter/category state through its inner enum/state types.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 client spellbook/filter presentation identity. Spell legality, rune consumption, combat effects and server-side execution remain outside this semantic layer.
